overview.problemStatement: Organizers need to publish an event, monitor registrations, admit attendees at the door, and delete an event without leaving orphan records behind.
overview.proposedSolution: A validated create-event form with Convex-hosted cover images and Clerk-billing Pro gating, a My Events list, a per-event dashboard with attendance statistics, in-browser QR check-in, attendee search and tabs, CSV export, and cascading deletion.
overview.targetAudience: Event organizers using the web app, from free accounts limited to one event to Pro accounts with unlimited events and custom colors.
assumptions: retroactive: true - documented from the existing implementation during brownfield onboarding; it is not a forward-looking product decision.
Pro entitlement is read from Clerk billing via has({ plan: "pro" }).
Paid tickets are collected offline; dashboard revenue is an estimate.
Check-in happens on the organizer's device at the venue.
outOfScope: Offline check-in or printed attendee lists.

userStories.title: Create a validated event
userStories.benefit: I cannot publish an incomplete or nonsensical event

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the form, title is at least 5 characters, description at least 20, category and city are required, capacity is at least 1, times match HH:MM, venue is a URL when provided, and end date/time must be after start.
Given a valid submission, the event is stored with a unique slug (<title-slug>-<timestamp>), organizer id and name, zero registrations, and creation is limited to three per minute.
Given a free account that already created one event, a second creation opens the upgrade dialog and is blocked; a non-default theme color also opens it; a Pro account bypasses both checks.
Given I pick an image, it is uploaded through a Convex storage upload URL and the stored value is a storage id, HTTPS URL, or data URL that the event page resolves to a displayable URL.

userStories.title: Manage and delete my events
userStories.want: a list of my events and a safe delete

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given I open /my-events, only my events are listed; deleting one requires confirmation, removes its registrations, deletes a stored cover image, and reclaims a free-event credit for free-ticket events.

userStories.title: Read attendance statistics
userStories.benefit: I can judge how the event is going

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given I open /my-events/[eventId] as the organizer, I see confirmed registrations, checked-in and pending counts, capacity, check-in rate, estimated paid revenue, hours until the event, and whether it is today or past; a non-organizer is rejected.

userStories.title: Check attendees in by QR
userStories.want: to scan a ticket QR code
userStories.benefit: I can admit attendees quickly and prevent reuse

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given a valid confirmed ticket for my event, scanning marks it checked in; unknown or cancelled codes are rejected, a second scan reports already checked in, non-organizers are rejected, and check-ins are limited to ten per minute.

userStories.title: Export the attendee list
userStories.benefit: I have an offline record for the door

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given an event with registrations, export downloads a CSV with name, email, registration time, checked-in flag, check-in time, and QR code; with no registrations it reports that there is nothing to export.

userStories.title: Search and filter attendees
userStories.benefit: I can find one person quickly

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given the attendee list, tabs separate all, checked-in, and pending registrations, and the search box matches attendee name, email, or QR code.

functionalRequirements.text: The create-event form MUST enforce the documented validation rules.
A valid submission MUST persist the event with a unique slug and zero registrations under a per-organizer rate limit.
Free accounts MUST be blocked from a second event and from non-default theme colors, with Pro bypassing both.
Cover images MUST be uploaded to Convex storage and resolved to a displayable URL.
My Events MUST list only the organizer's events and MUST cascade deletion through registrations and stored images.
The event dashboard MUST compute attendance and revenue statistics and MUST reject non-organizers.
QR check-in MUST validate the ticket, require the event organizer, reject invalid or cancelled tickets, be idempotent, and be rate-limited.
The attendee list MUST export to CSV.
The attendee list MUST support status tabs and name, email, or QR search.

nonFunctionalRequirements.text: Organizer-only operations MUST be enforced in Convex, not only in the UI.
Event creation and check-in MUST be rate-limited per organizer.
Management screens MUST remain usable at a 360px viewport with loading and empty states.
The feature MUST pass ESLint, TypeScript checking, and SpecDrive governance validation.

edgeCases.description: A free account has already created one event.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The upgrade dialog opens and no event is inserted.

edgeCases.description: A free account selects a custom theme color.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: The upgrade dialog opens and the color is not applied.

edgeCases.description: The end date/time is not after the start.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Submission is blocked with a toast.

edgeCases.description: The scanned QR is unknown or cancelled.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: An error is shown and no check-in is written.

edgeCases.description: The ticket was already checked in.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Already checked in is reported and no second write occurs.

edgeCases.description: A non-organizer opens the dashboard or scans a ticket.

edgeCases.expectedBehavior: Its registrations and stored cover image are removed.

edgeCases.description: The organizer exports with zero registrations.
edgeCases.expectedBehavior: A no-registrations message is shown and no file is produced.

risks.description: freeEventsCreated is incremented for every created event but reclaimed only for free-ticket events, so the free limit can drift.
risks.mitigation: Confirm the intended rule and align create/delete accounting before relying on the limit.

risks.description: Dashboard revenue is estimated from confirmed tickets while payment is collected offline.
risks.mitigation: Label revenue as an estimate; do not use it for reconciliation.

risks.description: A forwarded QR screenshot can be checked in before the real attendee arrives.
risks.mitigation: Idempotent check-in prevents double entry; add identity verification at the door if required.
